paragraphs.core_text: At the time when the Ambassador displayed his image, four great works were revealed that are very excellent and outstanding.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed 'Once again the enlightener speaks:' — formulaic dialogue frame attribution with no cosmological content.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Classic dialogue frame formula wrapping a substantive cosmological introduction. The introduction itself defines the four-fold enumeration structure — this is the teaching's skeleton. 'The Ambassador displayed his image' is core cosmic narrative.

paragraphs.core_text: The first is his image that he displayed in a glorious image.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First enumeration unit. Maps the Ambassador's first cosmic act. 'The first is...' is the enumeration marker — integral to the teaching structure. Both sides of the description stay within the cosmic system (Ambassador → image display).

paragraphs.core_text: The second is all the doors of the firmaments that were opened at that time. They open [...] and shut behind him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second enumeration unit. 'Doors of the firmaments' is cosmic geography — the structural boundaries between cosmic zones. Opening and shutting describes a cosmic process. Lacuna [...] indicates manuscript damage. Substrate vocabulary 'firmaments' confirmed by register score.

paragraphs.core_text: The third is the light and the releasing that was purified by his image. That light is more than the light that he shall [...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third enumeration unit. 'The light and the releasing' describes the cosmic purification mechanism — light extraction from matter via the Ambassador's image. Both sides map within the cosmic system (image → light purification). Sentence breaks off into lacuna.

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth: He has [made apparent], by the perfection of people, his light ship. He has [...] the living soul that shone forth in perfection and fullness over the worlds of enmity.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fourth enumeration unit. 'Light ship' = cosmic vessel (sun/moon ship). 'The living soul' = cosmic entity. 'Worlds of enmity' = cosmic geography (the realm of Darkness). 'Perfection of people' refers to the cosmic process of soul-perfection within the salvific narrative, not contemporary community. All mappings stay within the cosmic system. [made apparent] is editorial restoration of damaged text.
